positions.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
positions.catalyst: Friday pre-market: Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston reportedly said its optoelectronic components are effectively sold out through early 2029. LITE +4.2% pre (1092 vs 1048.60 close), COHR +3.4%, AAOI/POET up; Nasdaq futures +0.8% as AI/semis rebound from Thursday's OpenAI-revenue selloff (SOXL +4.4%, NVDA +1.8%, MU +1.8%). Oil eased after Trump said no Iran attack before midterms.
positions.driver: Company-specific, fresh, fundamental demand-visibility catalyst that directly rebuts the 'AI capex slowing' fear from OpenAI's revenue miss; +4.2% is a measured gap (not chased past 8%) with room for momentum follow-through as the open digests the comment. 1x matches medium-high conviction while holding over a weekend with Iran/Fed tail risk. Beat SOXL (3x into a weekend after a one-day dip-buy, gap risk too large), COHR (read-through only, wider spread), SPCX (+3.8% on spectrum deal but crowded retail name), GLD (+1.25% hedge, low upside), XLE hold (crude fading on de-escalation talk).
positions.risks: AI-capex sentiment re-breaks (more OpenAI/hyperscaler revenue doubts), hawkish Fed (Waller signalling two more hikes, 10Y ~5.3%), gap fade on 'sell the news' at the open, weekend Iran headline. Hard stop 1026.85 (-6%).
